field_text_formatted.value: The last of the four returning features is the one I'm most pleased with: a real code editor. The template field is now a CodeMirror editor, syntax-highlighted with HTML-aware auto-closing tags, instead of a plain textarea. More usefully, its autocomplete actually knows what each engine supports. Type {{ in a Twig formatter and it offers the variables in scope; type [ in an HTML+Token formatter and it offers Drupal tokens, including the [formatter_setting:...] ones; Ctrl+Space gives you context-appropriate suggestions in any engine.
